meta.title: Bloom & Wild: Creator Acquisition Case Study | Tano
meta.description: How Bloom & Wild drives monthly revenue through creator partnerships across brands and markets with Tano.

hero.title: How Bloom & Wild made creators a revenue channel
paragraphs: Creator partnerships drive monthly revenue across brands and markets.

blocks.html: Bloom & Wild’s seasonal products create a constant need to reach customers with fresh, relevant creative. Its brand team worked with creators through monthly gifting, while performance marketers wanted creator partnerships that could drive orders. The opportunity was to connect those activities into one acquisition programme.
The team wanted creator partnerships to drive orders, but slow onboarding, overlapping relationships and manual administration limited growth.
Traditional affiliate onboarding was slow. The team wanted to bring more creators into performance activity without adding more manual work.
Brand and performance teams approached creators from different angles. They needed to collaborate without competing for the same relationships.
Outreach, fee negotiations, contracts, unique codes and commission calculations were manual. Seasonal products also required fresh creative every month.
Tano connected creator sourcing, content capture and affiliate activity around Bloom & Wild’s existing teams. Automation removed repetitive work without making creator relationships feel impersonal.

items.title: Creator affiliate onboarding
items.body: Tano gave the team a route to onboard creators for performance activity and grow the affiliate programme.

items.title: A continuing supply of creators
items.body: Fresh creators supported monthly gifting and seasonal content needs, giving brand and performance teams more room to collaborate.

items.title: Choose content before buying rights
items.body: The team could review what creators produced, identify suitable content and request advertising rights, instead of committing upfront to unseen creative.

items.title: Captured content for paid media
items.body: Captured posts created a content library the team could return to when planning paid-media campaigns, rather than relying on screenshots and manual filing.

items.title: Reporting built around the business
items.body: Campaign structures and reporting reflected Bloom & Wild’s brands, markets, teams and terminology.

items.title: Less administration, familiar workflow
items.body: Less repetitive administration freed up the team’s time. Slack kept communication within its existing workflow, supported by responsive people who understood the account.

blocks.html: Bloom & Wild has established creators as a revenue-driving acquisition channel with Tano, generating revenue every month and achieving 125% higher click-through rates and 10% lower cost per acquisition.

The programme has expanded across brands and markets, bringing brand and performance teams together to drive acquisition through creator partnerships. Less time spent sourcing creators, managing communications and coordinating product sends means more capacity to grow the channel.
Tano enables the team to operate at a scale that would otherwise require at least one additional hire.
